ai_summary: Agro Phos (India) Limited, through its Registrar and Share Transfer Agent, confirms full compliance with SEBI Regulation 74(5) for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. This indicates all physical securities received for dematerialization were duly processed, accepted/rejected, listed, and records updated within the mandated 15-day timeframe, ensuring proper maintenance of shareholder records. No operational red flags regarding share transfer processes are present, although the future date of the filing (October 2026) for analysis purposes is a notable temporal discrepancy.
